bug_summary: prefixなしルーターの空pathバリデーションでpath/name取得に古いAPIを使っており、正しく検出できないケースがあった
pr_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/routing.py b/fastapi/routing.py
index f33b96479..fb4784309 100644
--- a/fastapi/routing.py
+++ b/fastapi/routing.py
@@ -2435,16 +2435,9 @@ class APIRouter(routing.Router):
                 "A path prefix must not end with '/', as the routes will start with '/'"
             )
         else:
-            for route, route_context in _iter_routes_with_context(router.routes):
-                if route_context is None:
-                    path = getattr(route, "path", None)
-                    name = getattr(route, "name", "unknown")
-                elif route_context.starlette_route is not None:
-                    path = getattr(route_context.starlette_route, "path", None)
-                    name = getattr(route_context.starlette_route, "name", "unknown")
-                else:
-                    path = route_context.path
-                    name = route_context.name
+            for r in _iter_included_route_candidates(router.routes):
+                path = getattr(r, "path", None)
+                name = getattr(r, "name", "unknown")
                 if path is not None and not path:

pr_description: The prefix-less path validation branched over route context variants (`starlette_route`, plain route context, or no context at all) just to read a `path`/`name` pair off whichever candidate it found. This switches to `_iter_included_route_candidates`, a single iterator that yields the candidates directly, so the loop body only needs one `getattr` pair instead of a three-way branch.
